request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Today (14 November 2026) the integrator completes the robot cell with the UR5e and UR10e arms. According to the robots' Declaration of Incorporation the integrator is responsible for the complete machine. Which steps does Article 5(1) of the act applicable today require of the integrator before the cell is put into service?

response.text: {"kind": "set", "value": ["ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex I", "ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available", "provide, in particular, the necessary information, such as instructions", "carry out the appropriate procedures for assessing conformity in accordance with Article 12", "draw up the EC declaration of conformity in accordance with Annex II, part 1, Section A and ensure that it accompanies the machinery", "affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 16"], "text": "Under Article 5(1) of Directive 2006/42/EC (the Machinery Directive, which still applies on 14 November 2026 because Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 applies only from 14 January 2027), the manufacturer or its authorised representative must, before placing the machinery on the market and/or putting it into service, complete six steps (a)–(f). The files do not use the word 'integrator'; the integrator is treated as the manufacturer only through the Article 2(i) definition, which the files state for the case where no manufacturer exists, so that link is an inference.", "sources": [{"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Art. 5(1) - Article 5 Placing on the market and putting into service", "quote": "Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall: (a) ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex I; (b) ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available; (c) provide, in particular, the necessary information, such as instructions; (d) carry out the appropriate procedures for assessing conformity in accordance with Article 12; (e) draw up the EC declaration of conformity in accordance with Annex II, part 1, Section A and ensure that it accompanies the machinery; (f) affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 16."}, {"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Article 2 Definitions", "quote": "‘manufacturer’ means any natural or legal person who designs and/or manufactures machinery or partly completed machinery covered by this Directive and is responsible for the conformity of the machinery or the partly completed machinery with this Directive with a view to its being placed on the market, under his own name or trademark or for his own use. In the absence of a manufacturer as defined above, any natural or legal person who places on the market or puts into service machinery or partly completed machinery covered by this Directive shall be considered a manufacturer;"}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Art. 54 - Entry into force and application", "quote": "It shall apply from 14 January 2027."}]}
